tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page and the map behind every loop.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: The inspector panel, list rows on hover, and every second ring's fill so nesting reads.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest. Carries `text` only.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons on hover. Carries `text` only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, spokes from a step to the loop it opens, list rules.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Names and body copy on `ground`, `ground-deep`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Timescales, sources and captions on `ground` and `ground-deep` only (it fails on `surface`).

tokens.name: text-off
tokens.usage: Froglet's disabled text. Not used for anything a reader needs.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The picked loop's ring, pressed buttons, links, the focus ring. A choice you can change again.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Text on a `selection` fill.

tokens.name: proposed
tokens.usage: The Proposed layer: new loops, proposed crossings, the fill of a hole, the step where a verb's feeling lands. Lime is a call you can still change.

tokens.name: proposed-fill
tokens.usage: The one call-to-action button. Carries `on-fill`.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text on `proposed-fill`.

tokens.name: planned
tokens.usage: The Planned layer: loops the plan has and the game lacks. Ruby is a commitment. Deep Sea uses ruby-76 so labels pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: hole
tokens.usage: A hole: the diamond count on a ring, an open question. Fire means deal with it. Always with a number or the word.

tokens.name: tier-0
tokens.usage: The Pulse tier's ring, bar and chip. One ordered blue ramp, stepped between Froglet's blue-60 and blue-84 (Deep Sea: slower is lighter; Shore: slower is darker). A mark, never body text.
